description: Post-checkout guest sends positive review + housekeeping FYI about missing sofa bed sheets. Must trigger cleaning alert AND auto-reply with warm acknowledgment. Real production case (Amy, Apt 2, Jun 19 2026).
guestMessage: We had a lovely stay.  Happy to give 5 starts.  The only thing was that there were no sheets for the sofa bed.  Just an fyi for the next folks. Thanks for your hospitality! Best, amy

conversationHistory.body: Hi Jerome and Ruby, we're looking forward to our stay. I just want to make sure there are sheets/blankets/pillows for our friend (our 4th) who will be sleeping on the couch. Please confirm. Thank you! -Amy
Good morning Amy, yes, we provide sheets, blankets, and pillows for anyone using the sofa bed. They're stored in the storage compartment under the sofa. Enjoy your stay!

Hi Amy,

It was a pleasure hosting you; I hope you had a great time in Portland and staying with us.
It would really mean a lot to me and will help enable other great guests like yourself to find my place on Airbnb if you give me a 5 star review. I hope you feel that I earned it.
Safe travel back to Boston and I hope to welcome you back to Portland in the near future!

Jerome & Ruby

requiredPhrases: heads up about the sofa bed

notes: Production incident: cleaning alert was missing (CleaningIssueTool missed 'no sheets'). Auto-reply was blocked by pre-send guard. Policy must override SLEEPING_ARRANGEMENTS misclassification from sofa-bed keywords.
